name: quota-guard
description: Claude Code mod: at or above a threshold of the 5-hour usage window (default 85%) asks before a new subagent (Agent) call starts, or refuses it if set to block, and toasts once when it crosses. Fails open if usage is unavailable.

threshold.title: Block subagents at this percent of the 5-hour window (default 85)
threshold.description: A number from 1 to 100. While the 5-hour window is at or above it, new Agent calls are refused until the window resets.

onLimit.title: At the limit: "ask" (default) or "block"
onLimit.description: ask: a dialog asks whether to start the subagent anyway (once, or until the window resets). block: refuse every new subagent until the window resets.
